data.name: Dino Epoch: Fantasy Tale
data.detailed_description:
You are the Chosen Spirit Medium, fallen into a world ruled by the fantastical Dino Beasts. On an exploratory path fraught with unknown perils and mortal dangers, you shall battle ferocious aberrant creatures, unravel ancient technologies, collect relics and resources, craft advanced tools, and build your homeland. Upgrade diverse abilities, vanquish prehistoric behemoths, and embark on a grand adventure to decode the mysteries of prehistoric technological energy.

Homeland Construction

Craft a unique dwelling with various materials and tools. Raise and strengthen your beloved companions, engage in crafting, farming and daily homeland management. Upgrade your settlement technologies and shape this prehistoric technological world to your own design. Customize your character appearance by choosing from a vast selection of sturdy armors and distinctive outfits suited for different scenarios.

Capture Adorable Companions

Venture through vibrant and distinctive ecological zones to capture pets with unique abilities. Discover their exclusive ecosystems and untold stories from before the darkness fell, deepening your understanding of this mysterious prehistoric world.

Boss Battles

Confront the regional bosses corrupted by darkness, and uncover the secrets of this shadow-stricken world from them. Train your captured companions to hone your combat skills, spend talent points to boost your stats, and devise tactical battle strategies to vanquish mighty prehistoric behemoths. Seek rare and potent energy stones to gain powerful assistance, gathering the energy needed to dispel the darkness.

Resource Exploration

Gather precious resources scattered across uncharted lands and collect valuable materials hidden in every region. Upgrade your diverse skills, unlock powerful weapons, and conquer the mythical beasts inhabiting each territory.

Pets with Unique Special Skills:

Capture pets endowed with exclusive signature abilities. They are your trump card for breaking through countless stages and the core winning factor to clear all obstacles ahead. When tackling challenging levels filled with deadly traps, conventional tactics will get you nowhere. Only by skillfully unleashing your pet’s exclusive special skills can you easily break all unique stage mechanics and breeze through every difficult level.

Explore with Friends

Embark on adventures alone, or team up with 2 to 4 players for seamless co-op exploration at any time. Play at your own pace and explore freely: witness the cycle of day and night, trade goods with merchants, hatch new beloved companions, and enjoy automatic resource gathering. Immerse yourself in this unforgettable sandbox adventure.

data.short_description: Tame a variety of wondrous dino‑creatures across the vast Dino Continent to fight, gather, build and produce for you. Venture together through this peril‑ridden yet adventure‑rich world. This is an open‑world survival‑building game supporting up to 4‑player online co‑op.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: 64-bit Windows 7, Windows 8.1, Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2GB / AMD Radeon R7 370 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card with the latest drivers

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
